en: Sadaqa informed us. Abd al-Rahman informed us, from Malik, from Zayd ibn Aslam, from his father, who said: Umar, may Allah be pleased with him, said: Were it not for concern for the Muslims who come later, I would not conquer a town without dividing it among its people, as the Prophet (peace be upon him) divided Khaybar.

en: Muhammad ibn Bashshar narrated to me. Ghundar narrated to us. Shu'ba narrated to us, from Amr, who said: I heard Abu Wa'il say: Abu Musa al-Ashari, may Allah be pleased with him, narrated to us that a Bedouin said to the Prophet (peace be upon him): A man fights for the spoils, a man fights so that he will be mentioned, and a man fights so that his position will be seen. Which of them is in the path of Allah? He said: Whoever fights so that Allah's word is supreme is in the path of Allah.

en: Abdullah ibn Abd al-Wahhab narrated to us. Hammad ibn Zayd narrated to us, from Ayyub, from Abdullah ibn Abi Mulayka, that the Prophet (peace be upon him) was given brocade robes fastened with gold buttons. He distributed them among some of his Companions and set one aside for Makhrama ibn Nawfal. Makhrama came with his son al-Miswar ibn Makhrama and stood at the door, saying: Call him for me. The Prophet (peace be upon him) heard his voice, took a robe, met him with it, and faced him with its buttons, saying: O Abu al-Miswar, I saved this for you. O Abu al-Miswar, I saved this for you. He was a man of a harsh character. Ibn Ulayya narrated it from Ayyub. Hatim ibn Wardan said: Ayyub narrated to us, from Ibn Abi Mulayka, from al-Miswar: Brocade robes were brought to the Prophet (peace be upon him). al-Layth followed him in this from Ibn Abi Mulayka.

en: Abdullah ibn Abi al-Aswad narrated to us. Mutamir narrated to us, from his father, who said: I heard Anas ibn Malik, may Allah be pleased with him, say: A man used to give the Prophet (peace be upon him) date palms until he conquered Qurayza and al-Nadir. After that, he returned them to him.
